title: chore: update app metrics 2026-10-02
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app request and repository metrics

gist.headline: The garden counts itself
gist.blurb: The daily app census refreshes request and repository metrics. Even gardens need a ledger.
gist.summary: The automated October 2, 2026 update refreshes app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json to keep internal app records current.
gist.impact: App-management records gain refreshed request and repository metrics; this does not change the user-facing API or apps.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the internal app registry as a cozy garden ledger, with request counters and repository icons beside code-plants. Polli, wearing a tiny accountant's visor, checks the figures; no specific metric values are implied.
